drafter.private_reasoning: I kept the draft commercial and standard-market while avoiding any disclosure of client-sensitive information. The revisions make the NDA clearly mutual, clarify that confidentiality obligations survive longer than the initial deal-term, and tighten the remedies language without overreaching.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thanks for circulating the first draft. We’ve made a few clean-up edits to align the NDA with a standard mutual form: clarifying that the agreement is mutual, tightening the confidentiality/term structure, and making the remedies language more conventional. Please let us know your thoughts, and we can turn quickly on the remaining points.

edits.text: PARTIES. This Agreement is between Northwind Capital and Oakstone Ventures (each, a “party,” and together, the “parties”).
edits.name: parties

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction and may exchange confidential information solely for that purpose.
edits.name: purpose

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS. Each receiving party shall keep the disclosing party’s confidential information confidential and use it only for the Purpose. These obligations shall continue for three years from the date of each disclosure; provided, however, that trade secrets shall be protected for so long as they remain trade secrets under applicable law.
edits.name: confidentiality

edits.text: 3. TERM. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing, but the parties’ confidentiality obligations with respect to information disclosed during that period shall survive as set forth in Section 2.
edits.name: term

edits.text: 4. REMEDIES. The parties acknowledge that a breach of this Agreement may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages may be an insufficient remedy, and that injunctive relief and any other equitable remedies may be sought, in addition to any other rights or remedies available at law or in equity.
edits.name: remedies

If you’re comfortable with that, we can move this toward signature quickly.

edits.text: 2. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS. Each receiving party shall keep the disclosing party’s confidential information confidential and use it only for the Purpose. These obligations shall continue for five years from the date of the last disclosure of the relevant confidential information; provided, however, that trade secrets shall be protected for so long as they remain trade secrets under applicable law.
